source: Synthetic demographic baseline for Minsk based on available city and national demographic statistics; not measured specifically for this bbox.

archetypes.name: children
archetypes.description: Lives with family; activity is concentrated around home, kindergarten or school and nearby recreation.

archetypes.name: school teenagers
archetypes.description: Attends school on weekdays and visits shops, food venues, sports and leisure locations after school.

archetypes.name: university students
archetypes.description: Studies on weekdays and frequently visits public transport hubs, cafes, shops and public spaces.

archetypes.name: young professionals
archetypes.description: Works or commutes on weekdays and actively uses cafes, retail, fitness and entertainment.

archetypes.name: working adults 30-39
archetypes.description: Full-time worker with regular weekday commute, shopping and service use.

archetypes.name: working adults 40-49
archetypes.description: Full-time worker with stable weekday routines and regular use of local services.

archetypes.name: working adults 50-59
archetypes.description: Works on weekdays with predictable commute and regular shopping and service activity.

archetypes.name: older working adults
archetypes.description: Economically active older resident combining work trips with local shopping and services.

archetypes.name: retired active adults
archetypes.description: Not employed; active during daytime and frequently visits shops, healthcare, parks and local services.

archetypes.name: older retirees
archetypes.description: Mostly neighbourhood-oriented with trips concentrated around groceries, pharmacies and healthcare.

archetypes.name: unemployed adults
archetypes.description: No regular workplace commute; flexible daytime mobility for errands, shopping and services.

archetypes.name: non-working adults
archetypes.description: Adults outside regular employment or study with flexible daytime activity.
